relationships.subject: BKR antagonists
relationships.evidence_quote: treatment with BKR antagonists, by intraperitoneal (i.p.), intraplantar (i.pl.), and intrathecal (i.t.) routes, mitigated CPIP-induced mechanical allodynia and oedematogenic response, but not cold allodynia

relationships.subject: BKR agonists
relationships.evidence_quote: i.pl. administration of BKR agonists exacerbated pain response
